scenario.label_zh: 核对打折商品的实付金额
scenario.goal_zh: 算清折扣后的金额并完成预算内的购买

context_zh: 顾客挑中一件外套，但需要先确认折扣是否适用及最终金额。
author: author-phase05-b

sentences.speaker: Cora
sentences.text: This jacket is fashionable, but sixty pounds is more than I wanted to spend.

sentences.speaker: Jamal
sentences.text: There is a twenty percent discount on it today.

sentences.speaker: Cora
sentences.text: Does that bring it down to forty-eight pounds?

sentences.speaker: Jamal
sentences.text: Yes. There are no other charges.

sentences.speaker: Cora
sentences.text: That is fairly close to my fifty-pound limit. Is this size included in the sale?

sentences.speaker: Jamal
sentences.text: It is. All sizes of this jacket have the same reduction.

sentences.speaker: Cora
sentences.text: Then I will take it. Here is my card.

sentences.speaker: Jamal
sentences.text: The payment has gone through. Here are your jacket and receipt.
